capabilities: sync a vault folder with a Memos server via its REST API
pull new server memos down as notes
push new notes up as memos
resolve concurrent edits with last-write-wins by timestamp
browse synced notes by date and first line in a list side panel
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents deliberate limitations: no delete propagation, no merge conflict resolution, and only note content syncs (no tags, visibility, or attachments).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a folder of notes in sync with a Memos server.

relations.evidence: Syncs a folder in your Obsidian vault with a Memos server via its REST API (/api/v1).

summary: Two-way sync plugin that mirrors a vault folder with a Memos server (usememos.com) via its REST API.
